landmarks.name: white bust on pedestal
landmarks.description: White marble bust on a tall white pedestal to the left of the first wooden double doorway.

landmarks.name: first wooden double doorway
landmarks.description: Open wooden paneled double doors with a pink carpet runner passing through.

landmarks.name: pink carpet runner
landmarks.description: Long pink floor runner guiding the path through the series of doorways and spaces.

landmarks.name: pink canopy bed
landmarks.description: Large ornate four-poster bed with pink drapes and bedspread against a pink wall.

landmarks.name: corner vase
landmarks.description: Large light-colored ornate vase on the floor near wooden wall paneling.

landmarks.name: light carved chairs and console table
landmarks.description: Two light-colored ornate carved armchairs with pink cushions and a matching marble-topped console table holding vases against the pink wall near the windows.

landmarks.name: second wooden doorway
landmarks.description: Open wooden doorway framed by columns leading out of the area with the pink canopy bed.

landmarks.name: dark carved table
landmarks.description: Heavy dark wood table with ornate carved legs near windows with pink curtains.

landmarks.name: dark fireplace with vases
landmarks.description: Dark stone fireplace mantel with light-colored ornate vases in front and on top.

landmarks.name: pink sofa with oval portrait
landmarks.description: Pink upholstered sofa beneath a large framed oval portrait of a woman in white.

landmarks.name: third wooden doorway
landmarks.description: Ornate wooden doorway with geometric paneling leading from the dark carved table area.

landmarks.name: white sculpture on pink pedestal
landmarks.description: White statue group resting on a pink draped cylindrical pedestal in the corner.

landmarks.name: patterned double doors
landmarks.description: Closed double doors with light-colored geometric and floral inlaid patterns.

landmarks.name: ornate console table with clock
landmarks.description: Gilded console table against the wall holding an ornate clock, beneath a portrait.

landmarks.name: fourth wooden doorway
landmarks.description: Open wooden doorway leading into the area with floral painted walls.

landmarks.name: floral painted walls
landmarks.description: Light-colored walls decorated with painted floral and vine patterns above wood wainscoting.

landmarks.name: dark floral table
landmarks.description: Rectangular table with a dark surface decorated with light floral patterns beneath a window.

landmarks.name: fifth doorway
landmarks.description: Open doorway on the left side of the floral-walled area leading into a darker space with a chandelier.

landmarks.name: ceramic garden stools
landmarks.description: Two barrel-shaped ceramic stools with dark and white bands against the wood wainscoting.

landmarks.name: wooden doorway with exit sign
landmarks.description: Open wooden doorway with a green exit sign above it, leading from the floral-walled area into the space with pink curtains and dark cabinets.

landmarks.name: pink curtains
landmarks.description: Tall pink drapes framing the windows on the left side of the space with landscape paintings.

landmarks.name: dark wooden cabinets and pink chairs
landmarks.description: Several dark ornate wooden cabinets on stands and pink upholstered chairs arranged along the right wall beneath large paintings.

landmarks.name: sixth wooden doorway
landmarks.description: Open wooden doorway leading from the landscape painting space into the large area with the central grey display wall.

landmarks.name: central grey display wall
landmarks.description: Long, freestanding modern grey partition wall in the center of the floor, featuring a recessed lit display of small paintings on one side.

landmarks.name: inlaid chest of drawers
landmarks.description: Ornate chest of drawers with light-colored floral and patterned inlays, flanked by tapestry-upholstered chairs beneath a large painting.

landmarks.name: pink canopy with footstool
landmarks.description: Tall pink fabric wall canopy and drapes above a low cushioned footstool on a patterned rug.

landmarks.name: seventh wooden doorway
landmarks.description: Open wooden doorway with a green exit sign above it, located next to the pink canopy with footstool.

landmarks.name: cream paneled double doors
landmarks.description: Closed cream and beige painted double doors set into the wall near the inlaid chest of drawers.

landmarks.name: freestanding portrait on easel
landmarks.description: Large full-length portrait of a man in uniform mounted in a heavy wooden freestanding frame near the windows.

landmarks.name: second inlaid chest of drawers
landmarks.description: Ornate chest of drawers with light-colored patterned inlays, flanked by tapestry-upholstered chairs on the window wall opposite the lit side of the grey display wall.

landmarks.name: arched alcove opening
landmarks.description: Wide archway at the far end of the space with the grey display wall, leading into an alcove with tall white curtains.

landmarks.name: alcove console table and pink chairs
landmarks.description: Ornate table holding two busts against tall white window curtains, flanked by two pink upholstered chairs and tall candelabras on pedestals inside the arched alcove.

landmarks.name: pink draped table
landmarks.description: Rectangular table covered in a pink cloth with a white trim stripe, located to the left just past the seventh wooden doorway.

landmarks.name: long table with high-backed chairs
landmarks.description: Large wooden table surrounded by tall, dark-framed, pink-upholstered chairs in the center of the floor under a painted coffered ceiling.

landmarks.name: ornate basin on pedestal
landmarks.description: Large light-colored sculpted basin or font on a carved stone pedestal base in front of windows with pink curtains.

landmarks.name: wooden sideboard with white vase
landmarks.description: Rectangular wooden cabinet against the pink wall holding a white vase, beneath two framed landscape paintings.

landmarks.name: eighth wooden doorway
landmarks.description: Open doorway with an ornate entablature and a small painting above it, located between the wooden sideboard and four pink chairs.

landmarks.name: dark cabinets with blue vases
landmarks.description: Two dark wood cabinets with light paneled doors and dark blue vases on top, separated by two pink chairs against the wood wainscoting.

landmarks.name: tall grandfather clock
landmarks.description: Tall narrow wooden floor clock in the corner next to a dark console table.

landmarks.name: four pink chairs in a row
landmarks.description: Four pink upholstered chairs lined up together against the wood wainscoting to the right of the eighth wooden doorway.

landmarks.name: grey information stand
landmarks.description: Freestanding modern grey rectangular lectern or display board near the windows and long table.

landmarks.name: checkered tile floor
landmarks.description: Floor with a diagonal grid pattern of grey, white, and pinkish-tan square tiles beyond the eighth wooden doorway.

landmarks.name: carved wooden staircase balustrade with statues
landmarks.description: Ornate dark wood balustrade with relief carvings and full-figure statues on pedestals along the descending stairs.

landmarks.name: circular floor basin
landmarks.description: Low circular stone rimmed pool or basin in the center of the checkered tile floor.

landmarks.name: dark inlaid writing desk
landmarks.description: Dark wood desk on legs with light-colored inlaid drawer fronts against the wood-paneled wall near a large arched window.

landmarks.name: ninth wooden doorway
landmarks.description: Open wooden paneled doorway with an ornate carved crest above it, located between the dark inlaid writing desk and the eighth wooden doorway along the checkered tile floor.

connections.how: Pass the white bust on your left and walk straight along the pink carpet runner to the first wooden double doorway.
Step through the first wooden double doorway and look ahead and to the left.
Walk past the pink canopy bed on your left toward the windows, then turn right along the pink carpet runner to face the second wooden doorway.
Pass through the second wooden doorway and follow the pink carpet runner straight between the dark carved table and pink sofa on your left and the dark fireplace on your right.

Go straight through the third wooden doorway along the pink carpet runner, passing the ornate console table with clock on your left and the white sculpture on pink pedestal and patterned double doors on your right.

Step through the fourth wooden doorway into the area with floral painted walls, passing the dark floral table on your left, and turn right at the ceramic garden stools to face the wooden doorway with exit sign.
Pass through the wooden doorway with exit sign and walk straight along the pink carpet runner with pink curtains on your left and dark wooden cabinets and pink chairs on your right.
Step through the sixth wooden doorway and turn right along the pink carpet runner with the central grey display wall on your left.

Continue along the central grey display wall past the cream paneled double doors on your right and the pink canopy with footstool ahead, then walk past the end of the central grey display wall toward the windows.

Turn around to face the lit side of the central grey display wall and walk straight along the pink carpet runner with the central grey display wall on your left and the second inlaid chest of drawers on your right.

connections.to: alcove console table and pink chairs
connections.how: Step through the arched alcove opening toward the tall white curtains.

connections.from: alcove console table and pink chairs
connections.how: Exit the arched alcove opening, keeping the unlit side of the central grey display wall on your left, and walk straight along the pink carpet runner past the sixth wooden doorway, inlaid chest of drawers, and cream paneled double doors on your right, and the pink canopy with footstool on your left.

Pass through the seventh wooden doorway and follow the pink carpet runner with the pink draped table, ornate basin on pedestal, and wooden sideboard with white vase on your left and the long table with high-backed chairs on your right.

Before passing through the eighth wooden doorway, continue along the wall past the four pink chairs in a row on your left and the long table with high-backed chairs on your right toward the far corner.
Turn around in the corner and walk back with the long table with high-backed chairs on your left and the four pink chairs in a row on your right.

Step through the eighth wooden doorway onto the checkered tile floor and walk straight between the carved wooden staircase balustrade with statues on your left and the dark inlaid writing desk on your right.
Turn around and walk across the checkered tile floor with the carved wooden staircase balustrade with statues on your right and the dark inlaid writing desk and ninth wooden doorway on your left.

Step out of the eighth wooden doorway onto the checkered tile floor, walk forward along the wood-paneled wall on your right, and turn right into the ninth wooden doorway just before the dark inlaid writing desk.
Pass through the ninth wooden doorway and walk straight along the pink carpet runner past the white bust on pedestal on your left.

walk_summary: Pass the white bust on pedestal on the left and enter through the first wooden double doorway along the pink carpet runner.
Look left at the pink canopy bed, then turn right past the corner vase and light carved chairs and console table to pass through the second wooden doorway.
Walk between the dark carved table and pink sofa with oval portrait on the left and the dark fireplace with vases on the right to pass through the third wooden doorway.
Continue past the ornate console table with clock on the left and the white sculpture on pink pedestal and patterned double doors on the right to pass through the fourth wooden doorway.

Step into the area with floral painted walls and the dark floral table on the left, glance toward the fifth doorway, then turn right past the ceramic garden stools to go through the wooden doorway with exit sign.
Follow the pink carpet runner between the pink curtains on the left and the dark wooden cabinets and pink chairs on the right to enter the sixth wooden doorway.
Turn right to walk between the central grey display wall on the left and the inlaid chest of drawers and cream paneled double doors on the right.
Approach the pink canopy with footstool and seventh wooden doorway, then walk past the end of the central grey display wall and the freestanding portrait on easel to the windows.

Turn around and walk along the lit side of the central grey display wall on the left, passing the second inlaid chest of drawers on the right, to enter the arched alcove opening and view the alcove console table and pink chairs.

Exit the alcove and walk back along the unlit side of the central grey display wall on the left, passing the sixth wooden doorway, inlaid chest of drawers, and cream paneled double doors on the right, and the pink canopy with footstool on the left, to pass through the seventh wooden doorway.

Walk past the pink draped table and ornate basin on pedestal on the left and the long table with high-backed chairs and dark cabinets with blue vases on the right toward the wooden sideboard with white vase and eighth wooden doorway.

Walk past the eighth wooden doorway and four pink chairs in a row on the left to the corner with the tall grandfather clock and grey information stand, then turn around and pass through the eighth wooden doorway.

Walk across the checkered tile floor between the carved wooden staircase balustrade with statues on the left and the dark inlaid writing desk on the right, passing the circular floor basin on the left.

Turn around at the far end of the staircase balustrade and walk back across the checkered tile floor, passing the circular floor basin, dark inlaid writing desk, and ninth wooden doorway on the left, to re-enter the eighth wooden doorway.
Step briefly toward the ornate basin on pedestal and grey information stand, then turn around past the wooden sideboard with white vase and exit back through the eighth wooden doorway.
Walk onto the checkered tile floor and turn right into the ninth wooden doorway before reaching the dark inlaid writing desk.

Walk past the white bust on pedestal on the left and through the first wooden double doorway, passing the pink canopy bed and corner vase on the left, and turn right at the light carved chairs and console table toward the second wooden doorway.

source.camera: held at chest height by a person walking
